info.title: Hakopod Management API
info.description: Durable container deployments. JSON or strict TOML specifications. An accepted 202 survives caller disconnection. Machine keys are scoped to project/environment; only admin keys may manage infrastructure or credentials.

X-Hakopod-Next-Cursor.description: Use as before to export the next page; each export contains at most 1000 events.

get.description: Administrator only. Lists are bounded: 32 destinations, 64 schedules, 100 jobs/artifacts per cursor page and 128 discovered targets. Destination storage location and encryption identity are immutable; PUT rotates credentials/name with expected_revision. Recovery keys are returned once on destination creation and must be saved separately. Restore always creates a fresh database and never overwrites an existing database.

get.description: One SSE reader; data JSON is {type:output,data:base64} or {type:exit,code:number,message:string}. Human deployment writer only. Four sessions, ten-minute lifetime, two-minute input-idle timeout; authority rechecked every five seconds.

get.summary: List provider configuration for administrators, or names and kinds granted to a deployment scope
Read provider configuration without credentials (administrator only)

put.summary: Create or update an external secret provider (administrator only)

409.description: Provider is referenced or its revision changed

post.description: GitHub push webhook. Requires X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC, X-GitHub-Delivery and X-GitHub-Event. Bounded durable inbox with retry and duplicate suppression.
GitLab.com push webhook authenticated with X-Gitlab-Token and deduplicated by X-Gitlab-Event-UUID. Provider-separated bounded durable inbox.

path.description: Relative path below the provider root; empty selects its root.

key.description: Vault string field or Infisical shared secret name.

personal.description: Personal projects cannot be shared through invitations or team membership.

deployment_mode.description: Effective validated deployment mode, including before first-owner setup. This does not enable public signup.

username.description: At most 256 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.
At most 256 UTF-8 bytes, without control characters.

password.description: At most 4096 UTF-8 bytes, without NUL or line breaks. Omit to keep the stored password.

id.description: Feature identifier. Paid capabilities include multi_team, oauth_login and enterprise_sso; availability comes from enabled.

ProxySettingsPatch.description: Changed HAProxy Technologies Kubernetes Ingress ConfigMap fields. Read the observed field catalog for supported names, types and bounds. All values are strings; an empty string resets a field, and omitted fields remain unchanged. Arbitrary directives are rejected.

environments.description: Empty means all environments of this project.

endpoint.description: Immutable HTTPS origin. Only installation administrators can configure providers.

ca_cert.description: Optional PEM certificate authority; TLS verification remains enabled.

private_cidrs.description: Explicit private network allowlist; loopback, link-local and metadata endpoints are always denied.

endpoint.description: Immutable HTTPS origin. Only installation administrators can configure providers.

ca_cert.description: Optional PEM certificate authority; TLS verification remains enabled.

private_cidrs.description: Explicit private network allowlist; loopback, link-local and metadata endpoints are always denied.

expected_revision.description: Zero creates; current revision updates access or credentials. Source location and network trust are immutable.

credentials.description: Required on create; omit on update to retain credentials. Vault requires token, Infisical requires client_id and client_secret.
